I am so incredibly sorry you are going through this. Hearing that you are crying every day and feeling so lonely is heartbreaking. Please know that the way he is treating you—the physical and mental abuse, the cheating, and the constant blame—is completely unacceptable and is never your fault. You deserve to be treated with respect and kindness, and his cruel words do not define your worth as a woman or as a person. 

Because you mentioned physical abuse, your safety is the absolute priority right now. Please consider reaching out to a domestic violence organization, such as the National Domestic Violence Hotline (call 1-800-799-SAFE or text "START" to 88788 in the US), or your local emergency services. Professionals there can offer confidential support, help you navigate this incredibly difficult situation, and assist you in creating a safe plan to protect yourself. You do not have to figure this out all by yourself, and there is help available when you are ready.
